about: Chapter 96 opens the Council's prophecies of Christ from the Law: the prophet like Moses (Deuteronomy 18), the bronze serpent as a figure of the cross (Numbers 21), and Israel at Sinai, whose fear of hearing God's word and seeing his face is read as a refusal of Christ.

sentences.n: Chapter heading. ፺፮ is the numeral 96. በእንተ 'concerning' + ትንቢት 'prophecy' (feminine noun) + ዘክርስቶስ, ዘ- 'of, that is' + ክርስቶስ 'Christ'. ዘ- here is the genitive marker, so 'the prophecy of Christ'; the chapter shows it means the prophecies concerning him, from the Law.

sentences.i: And again Moses proclaimed in the Law, and said: 'He will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers; hear that prophet. And every soul that does not hear that prophet, let that soul be cut off (?) from its people';
sentences.n: A quotation of Deuteronomy 18:15-19 (compare Acts 3:22-23). ወካዕበ 'and again'. ሰበከ 'he proclaimed' (3ms perfect, G). በኦሪት is በ- 'in' + ኦሪት 'the Law' (the Pentateuch). ወይቤ 'and he said' opens the quotation. ነቢየ is the accusative 'a prophet'; ያነሥእ is 3ms imperfect of አንሥአ 'raise up' (causative stem). ዘከማየ is ዘ- 'who is' + ከማ 'like' + -የ 'me'; እምአኀዊክሙ is እም- 'from' + አኀው 'brothers' (construct form አኀዊ-) + -ክሙ 'your' (2mp). ወስምዕዎ is the 2mp imperative ስምዑ 'hear!' + -ዎ 'him', with the object named after it by ለ- (ለውእቱ ነቢይ 'that prophet'). ነፍስ 'soul' is feminine, so the verb is ኢትሰምዖ 'she does not hear him' (3fs imperfect + -ዎ) and ይእቲ is 'that (f.)'. CRUX: ለትሠሮ is read as ለ- (the 3rd-person jussive particle) + ትሠሮ, 3fs, from ሠረወ 'root out, uproot' (?); the passive sense 'be cut off' is taken from the Deuteronomy/Acts parallel, not shown by the form (?). ሕዝባ is ሕዝብ 'people' + -ኣ 'her/its' (the soul's).

sentences.i: He said this about Christ, the Son of God. And again he prophesied about his crucifixion, and said: When serpents tormented (?) the children of Israel, they cried out to Moses, and Moses in turn cried out to God that he might save them from the beast of the earth (?); and God said to him: 'Make an image of a serpent of bronze (?), and hang it up where they may see (?) it; and everyone whom a serpent has bitten, shall look at that bronze image and he will live.' And when they delayed to look, they died; but those who looked at it and believed, lived;
sentences.n: Numbers 21:4-9, the bronze serpent, read as a type of the crucifixion (compare John 3:14). ዘንተ is the accusative 'this'; ተነበየ 'he prophesied' is a tä-stem; ስቅለቱ is ስቅለት 'crucifixion, hanging' + -ሁ 'his'. ሶበ 'when'. አመንደብዎሙ is a 3mp perfect + -ሙ 'them' with the object named after it by ለደቂቀ እስራኤል and አክይስት (plural of ከይሲ) as subject; CRUX: I cannot place the root of አመንደበ (it looks like a four-letter verb), and 'tormented, bit' is guessed from the story (?); ምንዳቤ 'distress' (from memory, unchecked) may belong to it, which would favour 'distressed, tormented'. አውየዉ 'they cried out' (3mp perfect, as in the glossary); ወሙሴሂ is 'and Moses too, in turn' (enclitic -ሂ). ከመ ያድኅኖሙ is ከመ + 3ms subjunctive of አድኅነ 'save' + -ሙ 'them'. አርዌ ምድር 'beast of the earth' (construct) is the standard phrase for a wild animal or serpent (?). ወይቤሎ 'and he said to him'; ግበር 'make!' (imperative); ሣዕለ is ሥዕል 'image' with a variant spelling (ሣ for ሥ; the next occurrence is ሥዕለ), in the construct before ከይሲ 'serpent'. ዘብርት is ዘ- + ብርት, taken as 'bronze' from the Numbers story (?). ወስቅሎ is the imperative ስቅል 'hang!' + -ዎ 'it'. CRUX: ኀበ ይትኤመርዎ 'where they may see it' is a tä-stem imperfect with -ዎ 'it'; the root (ኣመረ, seeing/showing) is not secure (?). ዘነሰኮ is ዘ- 'whom' + ነሰከ 'bit' + -ዎ 'him' (ከ + ዎ fuse as -ኮ); ይነጽሮ is the 3ms imperfect (volitive in force, 'let him look') of ነጸረ 'look' + -ዎ, anticipating ለውእቱ ሥዕለ ብርት 'that bronze image'; ወይሕየው 'and he will live'. ተህከዩ 'they delayed, were slow' (3mp perfect; the root ተሀከየ is a guess (?)) + ነጽሮ 'to look' (infinitive); ይመውቱ 'they die'; ወእለሰ 'and those, however'; ነጸርዎ 'they looked at it'; የሐይዉ 'they live'.

sentences.i: So it is with Christ: those who delayed and did not believe in him perish in Sheol, but those who believed and heard inherit the land of eternal life, where there is no sickness or pain for ever.
sentences.n: ወከማሁ 'and likewise' (ከማ 'like' + -ሁ). ለእለ is ለ- + እለ 'those who'; it names the group the verb is about ('as for those who...'), and the verb የኀልቁ 'they perish' (3mp imperfect of ኀልቀ) follows after ቦቱ 'in him' (በ- + -ቱ; አምነ ቦቱ 'believe in him'). ሲኦል 'Sheol' (the place of the dead, hell); በ- 'in'. ይወርሱ 'they inherit' (3mp imperfect of ወረሰ). ምድረ ሕይወት is a construct chain, 'land of life', and ዘለዓለም is ዘ- + ለዓለም 'of eternity'. ኀበ 'where'; አልቦ 'there is not'; ደዌ 'sickness'; ወሕማም 'and pain'; the last ዘለዓለም is 'for ever'.

And as for us, how is it that we do not hear the word of God, that we may believe in him?', God, who knows hearts, heard the murmuring of the children of Israel and said to Moses: 'You are here asking forgiveness for your people, while they speak against you, saying, "And as for us, how is it that God does not speak to us?"';

The object ለሙሴ is named after the verb, and the subject ደቂቀ እስራኤል follows it. እንዘ ይብሉ 'saying'. ለባሕቲቱኑ is ለ- + ባሕቲት 'solitude' + -ሁ 'his' + the question particle -ኑ: 'to himself alone, then?' ዘተና ገሮ is one word split by the wordspace, ዘ-ተናገሮ: ዘ- 'to whom' + ተናገረ 'spoke' + -ዎ 'him'. ወንሕነሰ 'and as for us'; እፎ 'how?'; ዘኢንሰምዕ 'that we do not hear'; ከመ ንእመን 'that we may believe' (1cp subjunctive of አምነ). ማእመሬ አልባብ 'knower of hearts' (construct; ማእመር, agent noun of አእመረ). ወአንተሰ 'and you, indeed'; ትስእል 'you ask' (2ms imperfect of ሰአለ); ስርየተ 'forgiveness' (accusative of ስርየት); ሐመዩከ 'they slandered you' (3mp perfect + -ከ). ለነሰ is ለ- 'to' + -ነ 'us' + -ሰ 'as for'; ዘኢይትናገረነ 'that he does not speak to us' (tä-stem, 3ms imperfect + -ነ 'us').

sentences.n: Exodus 19:10-15 (purifying and washing garments before Sinai) and 24:1. ወይእዜኒ 'and now' (enclitic -ኒ). ለእመ አምኑኒ is ለእመ 'if' + the 3mp perfect አምኑ + -ኒ, which is either '-ኒ me' (God speaking: 'if they believe me') or the enclitic 'also, indeed'; I take 'me' as the fitter sense in God's mouth (?). ይምጽኡ 'let them come' (3mp jussive); ኀቤየ 'to me'; ምስሌከ 'with you'. ወበሎሙ 'and say to them' (imperative). ከመ ያንጽሑ ርእሶሙ is a causative (Aʾ) subjunctive, 'that they cleanse their heads', an idiom for 'cleanse themselves'; ወይኅፅቡ 'and let them wash' (jussive). ዐበይተ እስራኤል 'the great ones, nobles of Israel' (construct plural of ዐቢይ). ወይዕርጉ 'let them go up'. ዘአነ እኤዝዞሙ is ዘ- 'what' + አነ 'I' + 1cs imperfect of አዘዘ 'command' + -ሙ 'them'; ቃልየ 'my word', ትእዛዝየ 'my commandment', and ዘአነ አዘዝኩ 'which I commanded' (1cs perfect).

sentences.i: Moses obeyed and told the children of Israel, and the people bowed down to God. They cleansed themselves on the third day, and seventy elders of Israel went up to Mount Sinai. They came out of the camp and went up to Mount Sinai, keeping apart (?) about a bowshot (?), each standing opposite his fellow. But they, as far as it lay in them (?), examined (?) their deeds, and were not able to go up into the tent (?) with Moses. Trembling and terror seized them, the shadow of death covered them, and they heard the sound of the horn and the harp (?), and the darkness and the wind;
sentences.n: Exodus 19-20 and 24:1, 9 (the elders at Sinai), with Hebrews 12:18-21. ወተአዚዞ is a converb (-ዎ ending) of the tä-stem ተአዘዘ, 'obeying', with Moses as its subject; ነገሮሙ is the verb ነገረ 'he told' + -ሙ 'them', not the noun ነገር 'word' glossed elsewhere. ወሰገዲ 'and they bowed' is written -ዲ for -ዱ (?). ወአንጽሑ ርእሶሙ is the Aʾ perfect 'they cleansed their heads', as in the last unit; በሣልስት ዕለት 'on the third day' (Exodus 19:11). ፸ is 'seventy' (spoken ሰብዓ); አእሩገ is the construct 'elders of'. ዐርጉ and ወፅኡ are 3mp perfects. ትዕይንት 'camp' (?). እንዘ ይትራሐቁ is a tä-stem 'keeping apart from one another, at a distance' (?), and መጠነ ምንዳፈ ሐጽ means 'as far as a throw/shot of an arrow' (?), my reading of ምንዳፍ as 'shooting' is a guess. በበ፩ is በበ 'each, by' + ፩ (spoken አሐዱ 'one'), 'one by one'; በአንጻረ is በ- + አንጻር 'in front of', construct before ቢጹ 'his fellow'. CRUX: ወእሙንቱሰ መጠነ ቦሙ ፈተኑ ምግባሮሙ: ቦሙ 'in them', ፈተነ 'test, examine' (?); 'examined their deeds as far as was in them' is my best reading (?) and the clause could mean 'they were tried in their deeds'. ኢክህሉ ዐሪገ 'they could not go up' (infinitive). ቆባር, here 'tent' (?), unattested in my aids. አኀዞሙ 'seized them'; ረዓድ 'trembling', ድንጋፄ 'terror'. ደፈኖሙ is 'covered them' (ደፈነ, ?); ጽላሎተ ሞት 'the shadow of death' is an accusative construct, either a second object or the subject in accusative form (compare Psalm 23:4). ቃለ is the construct 'sound of'; ዕንዚራ is a stringed instrument (?); 'darkness and wind' are joined to the list, so 'heard' is stretched over them.

sentences.n: ወቦአ 'and he entered' (3ms perfect, G); ተናገረ ምስለ 'spoke with'. ኵሎሙ is 'all of them', before ዐበይተ እስራኤል (construct). ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር is 'that word of God', the demonstrative placed before its noun; ቃለ is the construct. ፈርሁ 'they feared' (3mp perfect); ወርዕዲ 'and they trembled' (ርዕደ), written -ዲ for -ዱ as in ሰገዲ (?). ኢክህሉ ቀዊመ 'they could not stand' (infinitive of ቆመ). እምብዝኀ ፍርሀት is እም- 'from' + the construct ብዝኅ 'abundance of' + ፍርሀት 'fear'; ዘውስተ ልቦሙ 'which was in their heart'.

sentences.i: And when Moses came out, they said to him: 'Let us not hear this word of God, lest we die of terror. Behold, we know that God has spoken to you. And if there is anyone to tell us, you listen and tell us, and be a mouth for us before God, and we shall be his own people.' Do you see how they denied Christ, saying, 'Let us not hear that Word, lest we die of terror'?
sentences.n: ይቤልዎ 'they said to him' (ይቤሉ + ሎ, written -ልዎ). ኢንሰምዓ is the negated 1cp imperfect (ንሰምዕ), used as a refusal, 'we do not hear' / 'let us not hear', with -ኣ '(her) it' agreeing with the feminine demonstrative ለዛቲ (ዛቲ with the masculine ቃል is odd, ?); ከመ ኢንሙት 'lest we die' (1cp jussive); በድንጋፄ 'in terror'. ወናሁ አእመርነ 'and behold, we know' (1cp perfect), ከመ ተናገረከ 'that he has spoken to you'. ወለእመቦ is ወ- + ለእመ 'if' + ቦ 'there is'; ዘይነግረነኬ is 'who will tell us' (3ms imperfect + -ነ 'us') with the emphatic enclitic -ኬ. Imperatives: ስማዕ 'hear!', ንግረነ 'tell us!', ኩነነ 'be (for) us!'. አፈ በኀበ እግዚኣብሔር 'a mouth before God'. ንከውኖ is ንከውን 'we shall be' + -ዎ 'to him', then ሕዝበ ዚአሁ 'a people his own'. ትሬእዩኑ is 2mp imperfect of ርእየ + -ኑ (question particle), 'do you see?', the writer turning to the reader. ዘከመ ክሕድዎ ለክርስቶስ is 'how they denied Christ' (ክሕደ + -ዎ); the clause runs on into ወይቤሉ 'and they said'. ኢንሰምዖ ... ለውእቱ ቃል is 'let us not hear it (m.)'.

glossary.ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?) · accusative 'a voice' (ቃለ ሠናየ 'a good voice') · 'sound of' (construct: ቃለ ቀርን 'sound of the horn')
glossary.በሣልስት: ሣልስ — on the third (በ- + ordinal ሣልስ, fem. ሣልስት, agreeing with ዕለት)
glossary.በሲኦል: ሲኦል — as Sheol, by Sheol (በ- 'as, by means of' + proper noun) · 'in Sheol' (በ- 'in', of place, + ሲኦል: የኀልቁ በሲኦል 'they perish in Sheol')
glossary.በበ፩: በበ — each, by (distributive); ፩ spoken አሐዱ (ʾaḥadu) 'one', so በበ አሐዱ (bä-bä ʾaḥadu) 'one by one, each one'
glossary.በኀበ: ኀበ — before, with, in the presence of (በ- + ኀበ) · among (በኀበ ማእምራን 'among the knowing') · 'where' (conj.) (በኀበ ሀለውኩ 'where I am') · 'of, from' after ሰአለ (ሰአሉ በኀበ እግዚኣብሔር 'they asked of God')
glossary.በአንጻረ: አንጻር — opposite, in front of (በ- + noun; construct 'in front of')
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam') · 'because' before a perfect verb (በእንተ ተዘብጡ 'because they were struck') · 'because' before ዘ- + verb (በእንተ ዘነሥኦሙ 'because he took them'; በእንተ ዘአፍቀርኪያ 'because you loved her')
glossary.በኦሪት: ኦሪት — in the Law, in the Pentateuch (በ- 'in' + noun, fem.)
glossary.በዝየ: ዝየ — here (በ- + adverb ዝየ 'here'; the በ- adds nothing to the sense)
glossary.በግላ: ግላ — by a veil (?) (በ- 'by' + noun ግላ, read as 'veil'; word unconfirmed) (?)
glossary.ብሂል: ብሂል — saying, meaning, 'that is' (verbal noun of ብህለ)
glossary.ብርት: ብርት — (?) a metal or common material; word unconfirmed (compare Amharic ብረት 'iron')
glossary.ቦሙ: በ — by them, in them (preposition በ- + -ሙ '3mp', ቦሙ)
glossary.ተህከዩ: ተሀከየ — they delayed, were slow (3mp perfect, tä-stem; spelled with ህ) (?)
glossary.ተህየይዎ: ተሀየየ — they rejected, neglected him (?) (3mp perfect, tä-stem + -ዎ '3ms him'; taken as ተሀየየ, compare ተሀየይዎ in earlier parts; spelled with ህ) (?)
glossary.ተነበየ: ተነበየ — he prophesied (3ms perfect, tä-stem of ነበየ, n-b-y)
glossary.ተናገረከ: ተናገረ — he spoke to you (3ms perfect, tä-stem + -ከ '2ms you')
glossary.ትሬእዩኑ: ርእየ — do you see? (2mp imperfect, G + question particle -ኑ)
glossary.ትእዛዝየ: ትእዛዝ — commandment (noun, singular, possibly collective; from አዘዘ; + -የ 'my', 1cs)
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
glossary.ነገሮሙ: ነገር — their words (noun + -ሙ '3mp their') · 'he told them' (the verb ነገረ, 3ms perfect, G + -ሙ '3mp them', not the noun: ተአዚዞ ሙሴ ነገሮሙ ለደቂቀ እስራኤል 'Moses told the children of Israel')
glossary.ነጸርዎ: ነጸረ — they looked at it/him (3mp perfect, G + -ዎ '3ms')
glossary.ነጽሮ: ነጸረ — looking, to look (verbal noun/infinitive ነጽሮ of ነጸረ)
glossary.ነጽሮተ: ነጽሮት — looking at, sight of (verbal noun, fem.; construct / accusative)
glossary.ናየድዐክሙ: አየድዐ — we shall inform you (1cp imperfect, ʾa-stem causative of y-d-ʿ + -ክሙ '2mp you') (?)
glossary.ንእመን: አምነ — that we may believe (1cp subjunctive, G)
glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
glossary.አመንደብዎሙ: አመንደበ — they afflicted, tormented them (3mp perfect + -ሙ '3mp them'; four-letter verb, apparently from ምንዳቤ 'affliction') (?)
glossary.አሜሃኒ: አሜሃ — even then, then also (adverb + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.አምኑኒ: አምነ — they believed me (?) (3mp perfect, G + -ኒ, read as '1cs me'; or enclitic -ኒ 'also, indeed') (?)
glossary.አርእየኒ: አርአየ — show me! (2ms imperative, causative Aʾ-stem of ርእየ + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.አእሩገ: አረጋዊ — elder, old man (plural አእሩግ (?); construct 'elders-of')
glossary.አክይስት: ከይሲ — serpents (plural አክይስት of ከይሲ, noun)
glossary.አውየወ: አውየወ — he cried out, wailed (3ms perfect; compare known አውየዉ) (?)
glossary.አውየዉ: አውየወ — they cried out, wailed (3mp perfect; related to the noun አውያት 'wailing') (?)
glossary.አፈ: አፍ — mouth of (noun, construct state; አፈ እግዚኣብሔር 'mouth of God')
glossary.ኢትሰምዖ: ሰምዐ — she does not hear him (ኢ- + 3fs imperfect, G + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ኢነአምኖ: አምነ — we do not believe him (ኢ- + 1cp imperfect indicative, G + -ዎ '3ms him'; not the subjunctive ንእመን)
glossary.ኢንሙት: ሞተ — that we not die, lest we die (ኢ- + 1cp subjunctive, G)
glossary.ኢንርአይ: ርእየ — that we not see (ኢ- + 1cp subjunctive, G)
glossary.ኢንሰምዓ: ሰምዐ — we do not hear it, let us not hear it (ኢ- + 1cp imperfect, G, used as a refusal, + -ኣ '3fs it', agreeing with ዛቲ)
glossary.ኢንሰምዖ: ሰምዐ — we do not hear it, let us not hear it (ኢ- + 1cp imperfect, G, used as a refusal, + -ዎ '3ms it')
glossary.ኢንስምዖ: ሰምዐ — let us not hear it (ኢ- + 1cp jussive, G + -ዎ '3ms it'; the jussive spelling of the words ኢንሰምዖ)
glossary.ኢይክሉ: ከሀለ — they cannot (ኢ- + 3mp imperfect, G 'be able')
glossary.ኢፈተዉ: ፈተወ — they did not wish (ኢ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.እምሕዝባ: ሕዝብ — from her people (እም- 'from' + noun + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.እምብዝኀ: ብዝኅ — from the abundance of (እም- 'from' + noun ብዝኅ 'multitude', construct ብዝኀ)
glossary.እምትዕይንት: ትዕይንት — from the camp (እም- 'from' + noun, fem.) (?)
glossary.እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"' · 'than' in a comparison (ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced more than Israel')
glossary.እምአርዌ: አርዌ — from the beast (እም- 'from' + noun አርዌ 'beast, wild animal, serpent'; construct before ምድር)
glossary.እምአኀዊክሙ: አኀው — from your brothers (እም- 'from' + noun, construct form አኀዊ- + -ክሙ '2mp your')
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?) · 'of' before a genitive, standing for the feminine relative (ሃይማኖት እንተ አበው ሐዋርያት 'the faith of the fathers, the apostles'; ሃይማኖተ እንተ ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'the faith of the Church') · fem. relative before a verb with the object understood (ሥጋ እንተ ነሥአ 'the flesh which he took')
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እኤዝዞሙ: አዘዘ — I command them (1cs imperfect, G + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ክሕድዎ: ክሕደ — they denied him (3mp perfect, G + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — all of them (+ -omu) · before a noun, 'all' (ኵሎሙ አድያመ ኢትዮጵያ 'all the regions of Ethiopia', ch. 55)
glossary.ወለእመቦ: እመ — and if there is (ወ- + ለእመ conditional + ቦ 'there is')
glossary.ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
glossary.ወሙሴሂ: ሙሴ — and Moses also, in turn (ወ- + proper name + enclitic -ሂ)
glossary.ወርዕዲ: ርዕደ — and they trembled (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G; spelled ወርዕዲ for ወርዕዱ) (?)
glossary.ወሰምዑ: ሰምዐ — and they heard (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, s-m-ʿ)
glossary.ወሰገዲ: ሰገደ — and they bowed down (ወ- + 3mp perfect, spelled ሰገዲ for ሰገዱ) (?)
glossary.ወስምዕዎ: ሰምዐ — and hear him! (ወ- + 2mp imperative ስምዑ + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ወስቅሎ: ሰቀለ — and hang it! (ወ- + 2ms imperative ስቅል + -ዎ '3ms it')
glossary.ወሶበ: ሶበ — and when (ወ- + conjunction) · and Sobo (ወ- + proper name ሶበ, in the list of lands ruled by the Ishmaelites, ወሶበ ወኵርጒ; unidentified) (?)
glossary.ወቃልሰ: ቃል — and the Word indeed (ወ- + noun + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወበሎሙ: ብህለ — and say to them (ወ- + imperative በል of ብህለ, ይቤ 'say' + -ሙ 'them')
glossary.ወቦአ: ቦአ — and he entered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
glossary.ወተናገረ: ተናገረ — and he spoke (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወትሬኢ: ርእየ — and she sees (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, G) · 'and you will see' (ወ- + 2ms imperfect, G: ወትሬኢ በውስተ ኰኵሕ 'and you will see in the rock')
glossary.ወንሕነሰ: ንሕነ — and as for us (ወ- + 1cp independent pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወንከውኖ: ኮነ — and we shall be to him (ወ- + 1cp imperfect, G + -ዎ '3ms to him')
glossary.ወንግረነ: ነገረ — and tell us! (ወ- + 2ms imperative, G + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወአሜሃ: አሜሃ — and then, at that time (ወ- + adverb)
glossary.ወአምኑ: አምነ — and they believed (ወ- + 3mpl perfect, ʾ-m-n)
glossary.ወአኀዞሙ: አኀዘ — and he/it seized them (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወአንተሰ: አንተ — and as for you (ወ- + 2ms pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወአንጽሑ: አንጽሐ — and they cleansed (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative Aʾ-stem)
glossary.ወኢአምኑ: አምነ — and they did not believe (ወ- + ኢ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወኢክህሉ: ከሀለ — and they could not (ወ- + ኢ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወእለሰ: እለ — and those who indeed (ወ- + relative pl. + ሰ 'indeed')
glossary.ወእሙንቱሰ: እሙንቱ — and they, indeed (ወ- + 3mp pronoun + enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወከማሁ: ከማሁ — and likewise (ወ- 'and' + adverb, 'like him, thus')
glossary.ወኩነነ: ኮነ — and be for us! (ወ- + 2ms imperative ኩን + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix) · and everyone (ወኵሉ ያነክር 'and everyone marvels')
glossary.ወወፅኡ: ወጽአ — and they came out (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወዐርጉ: ዐርገ — and they went up (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወዕንዚራ: ዕንዚራ — and ዕንዚራ (?) (ወ- + noun; a stringed instrument, perhaps a harp or lyre) (?)
glossary.ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
glossary.ወዘከመሂ: ዘከመ — and however, in whatever way (ወ- 'and' + ዘከመ 'as, how' + enclitic -ሂ)
glossary.ወየሐዩ: ሐይወ — and they shall live (ወ- + 3mp imperfect) · 'and live' after a singular subject ('see my face and live'; plural form beside ዘይክል) (?)
glossary.ወይሕየው: ሐይወ — and he will live (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ወይስምዑ: ሰምዐ — and let them hear (ወ- + 3mp jussive, G)
glossary.ወይቤሉ: ብህለ — and they said (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l)
glossary.ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይኅፅቡ: ኀጸበ — and let them wash (ወ- + 3mp jussive, G)
glossary.ወይዕርጉ: ዐርገ — and let them go up (ወ- + 3mp jussive, G)
glossary.ወይግበሩ: ገብረ — and they shall make (ወ- + 3mp jussive/imperfect)
glossary.ወደፈኖሙ: ደፈነ — and it covered them (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G + -ሙ '3mp them') (?)
glossary.ወድንጋፄ: ድንጋፄ — and dismay, terror (ወ- + noun; also spelled ድንጋጼ)
glossary.ወፅአ: ወጽአ — he came out (3ms perfect, G; written ወፅአ)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is') · 'that' (demonstrative before a noun: ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'that word of God')
glossary.ዐበይተ: ዐቢይ — great (adjective; plural ዐበይት, accusative form) · as a noun, 'great ones, notables' (construct, ዐበይተ እስራኤል 'notables of Israel')
glossary.ዘለዓለም: ለዓለም — everlasting, eternal (ዘ- 'of' + ለዓለም 'for ever'; ክብረ ዘለዓለም 'glory of eternity') · 'for ever' as an adverb after a noun (ደዌ ዘለዓለም 'sickness for ever')
glossary.ዘብርት: ብርት — of/which (ዘ- + ብርት); the word is unidentified, perhaps 'bronze' (cf. ch. 9–12) so 'of bronze' (?)
glossary.ዘተና: ተናገረ — to whom he spoke (ዘ- relative + ተና-, the first half of ዘተናገሮ split by the wordspace; completed by ገሮ)
glossary.ዘነሰኮ: ነሰከ — whom [a serpent] has bitten (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G + -ዎ '3ms him', ከ + ዎ fuse as -ኮ)
glossary.ዘአነ: አነ — what I (ዘ- 'that which' + pronoun አነ 'I')
glossary.ዘኢንሰምዕ: ሰምዐ — that we do not hear (ዘ- 'that' + ኢ- + 1cp imperfect, G)
glossary.ዘኢይትናገረነ: ተናገረ — that he does not speak to us (ዘ- 'that' + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
glossary.ዘእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — whom God (made king, etc.) (ዘ- 'the one whom' + noun as subject of the following verb; ዘእግዚኣብሔር አንገሠ 'whom God made king') · 'of God', ዘ- as genitive marker after a noun (ቤተ ክርስቲያን ዘእግዚኣብሔር 'the church of God') · 'of God' (ዘ- genitive 'of' + noun: ቃል ዘእግዚኣብሔር 'the Word of God')
glossary.ዘከማየ: ከማ — who is like me (ዘ- relative + ከማ 'like' + -የ '1cs me')
glossary.ዘክርስቶስ: ክርስቶስ — of Christ (ዘ- 'of, that is' + proper name)
glossary.ዘይቤሉ: ብህለ — what they said (ዘ- 'what' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l)
glossary.ዘይነግረነኬ: ነገረ — who will tell us (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G + -ነ '1cp us' + emphatic -ኬ)
glossary.ዘይክል: ከሀለ — who is able (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G, k-h-l)
glossary.የኀልቁ: ኀልቀ — they perish, come to an end (3mp imperfect, G)
glossary.ያነሥእ: አንሥአ — he will raise up (3ms imperfect, causative Aʾ-stem)
glossary.ያንጽሑ: አንጽሐ — that they cleanse (3mp subjunctive, causative Aʾ-stem)
glossary.ያድኅኖሙ: አድኅነ — that he save them (3ms subjunctive, causative Aʾ-stem of ድኅነ + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ይምጽኡ: መጽአ — that they come (3mpl subjunctive, after ከመ) · 'let them come' (3mp jussive standing alone: ይምጽኡ ኀቤየ 'let them come to me')
glossary.ይስምዑ: ሰምዐ — they hear (3mp imperfect, G) · 'that they hear' (3mp subjunctive after ከመ: ከመ ይስምዑ 'that they may hear')
glossary.ይቤሉ: ብህለ — they said (3mp perfect ይቤሉ, b-h-l)
glossary.ይቤልዎ: ብህለ — they said to him (3mp perf. ይቤሉ + ሎ 'to him', written ይቤልዎ)
glossary.ይብሉ: ብህለ — they say (3mp subjunctive/imperfect, after እንዘ 'saying') · 'let them say, let them call' (3mp jussive, ሎሙሰ ይብሉ አማልክቲሆሙ 'as for them, let them call them their gods')
glossary.ይትራሐቁ: ተራሐቀ — they keep apart, at a distance from one another (3mp imperfect, reciprocal tä-stem of ርሕቀ 'be far') (?)
glossary.ይትኤመርዎ: ተአመረ — that they may see, perceive it (?) (3mp subjunctive, tä-stem + -ዎ '3ms it'; root ʾ-m-r 'know, show', sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.ይትዐወቅ: ተዐወቀ — it is known (3ms imperfect, passive tG-stem of ዐወቀ)
glossary.ይነጽሮ: ነጸረ — he looks at it, shall look at it (3ms imperfect, G + -ዎ '3ms it'; volitive in force, 'let him look')
glossary.ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day') · 'she' restating the subject, a resumptive pronoun before a noun (ይእቲ ባሕርይ 'she, the pearl')
glossary.ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
glossary.ገሮ: ተናገረ — second half of ዘተናገሮ, '-ገሮ' (3ms perfect, tä-stem, ተናገረ + -ዎ '3ms him'; split word, completes ዘተና)
glossary.ጸልእዎ: ጸልአ — they hated him (3mp perfect, G + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ጽላሎተ: ጽላሎት — shadow (noun, fem.; accusative / construct 'shadow of')
glossary.ፈተኑ: ፈተነ — they tested, examined (3mp perfect, G) (?)
glossary.፺፮: ፺፮ — ninety-six (numeral); spoken ተስዓ ወስድስቱ (täsʿa wä-sədsətu) 'ninety-six'
